entries.speaker: Futaba

entries.en: Shuddup!

Sorry.

entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But as your teammate... and, um, your[n]girlfriend... I gotta ask.

entries.speaker: Futaba

entries.speaker: Futaba

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...But, y'know, thanks.

entries.en: This is just me thinking out loud, but...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I only wanted one thing when I joined[n]the Phantom Thieves. To find out why[n]my mom died.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But now, I've got one more person[n]to help.

Who?
